no-agents.title: No agents yet
no-agents.summary: A workspace with no agents has no actor to run sessions.
no-agents.desc: This workspace is empty. Create an agent or install a ready-made template from the market.

workdir.title: Set a working directory
workdir.summary: Without a default working directory, sessions start in the physical workspace directory.
workdir.desc: Choose a default working directory so sessions start with that root, Git branch, and CLAUDE.md context.

cbm-add.title: Add the code knowledge graph
cbm-add.summary: codebase-memory-mcp is installed on PATH but has not been added as an MCP server.
cbm-add.desc: codebase-memory-mcp is installed but has not been added to this workspace. Add it as an MCP server for sub-millisecond, low-token code search and navigation.

cbm-enable.title: Enable the code knowledge graph
cbm-enable.summary: The codebase-memory MCP server is added, but its workspace toggle is off.
cbm-enable.desc: The codebase-memory MCP server is present but disabled in this workspace. Enable it to turn on automatic indexing and codebase_workspace_search.

zvec-add.title: Add semantic search
zvec-add.summary: zvec-grep (zg) is installed on PATH but has not been added as an MCP server.
zvec-add.desc: zvec-grep is installed but has not been added to this workspace. Add it as an MCP server so agents can find unfamiliar code and documents by intent while the working directory is indexed in the background.

zvec-enable.title: Enable semantic search
zvec-enable.summary: The zvec-grep MCP server is added, but its workspace toggle is off.
zvec-enable.desc: The zvec-grep MCP server is present but disabled in this workspace. Enable it to add search guidance to the agent context and automatically index the working directory.

token.title: Connect token optimization
token.summary: sqz is installed, but its output-compression hook is not connected.
token.desc: sqz is installed on this device but is not connected. Add it as a hook to compress tool output without losing information and save tokens.

shell-compress.title: Enable shell output compression
shell-compress.summary: sqz is installed, but in-process shell output compression is inactive because no hook is connected and automatic mode is disabled.
shell-compress.desc: sqz is installed, but shell output compression is inactive in this workspace. Enable it to shorten shell output losslessly with in-process sqz before it reaches the model. It does not require a hook; the hook path does not run for bridged tools.

terse-mode.title: Enable Terse Mode
terse-mode.summary: The terse prompt that condenses response style is disabled in this workspace.
terse-mode.desc: Terse Mode is off. Enable it to reduce filler in agent responses while preserving technical content such as code, commands, file paths, and error text exactly, noticeably reducing output tokens.

no-mcp.title: No MCP sources
no-mcp.summary: There are no MCP servers and neither codebase-memory nor zvec-grep is pending as a more specific recommendation.
no-mcp.desc: Add an MCP server to connect external data or tools, either from the market or by importing .mcp.json.

backup-off.title: Backups are off
backup-off.summary: Periodic zip backups are disabled across the app.
backup-off.desc: Periodic zip backups are off. Enable them to back up every workspace regularly.

tool-update.title: External tool updates available
tool-update.summary: A newer release exists for an installed external tool.
tool-update.oneClick_one: {{count}} can be updated with one click; the others require a manual update because TionHarness does not overwrite a binary locked by a running child process.
tool-update.oneClick_other: {{count}} can be updated with one click; the others require a manual update because TionHarness does not overwrite a binary locked by a running child process.
tool-update.manual: These tools are updated manually because TionHarness does not overwrite a binary locked by a running child process; the screen provides step-by-step instructions.

cli-tools.title: CLI tools are installed
cli-tools.summary: CLI tools on PATH, such as mmdc, can be called directly from Bash.
cli-tools.desc: {{tools}} is installed on this device — agents can call it directly from Bash during development.
